entities.summary: Aeroflot Flight 141 was an international passenger flight from Moscow to Prague. On 19 February 1973, the Tupolev Tu-154 operating the flight crashed approximately 1.5 kilometers short of runway 25 at Prague Ruzyně Airport. While most passengers initially survived the impact, many perished in the subsequent fire.
